label: B2 from a local existence PSR for contingents and two reason bridges
meaning: A being x contingent at w has some reason r for its existence at w (local existence PSR for contingents). By BX1 the being r is about is not x; by BX2 that other being causes x's esse. So x has a distinct CAUSE_2 of its esse. The #312 tokens sit on the frame's own existence, and BX2's cause is the frame's CausesIn at esse, so the conclusion is B2 on the same frame. It splits B2 into a reason-coverage half, which the brute-contingency rival denies, and a reason-to-cause half (BX1, BX2), which a rival with non-causal reasons for contingent existence would deny.
